name: American Express

Engineer Trainee / SE1 (India campus).dsaDepth: Moderate — an OA (tree/DP-style problems) then 2 technical rounds and an HR round; fundamentals and clean communication matter more than raw algorithm difficulty
rounds: Online test: 3 coding questions (e.g. a tree problem, the classic Frog Jump DP problem)

Technical round 1: live coding plus project/resume discussion (web-scraping and similar practical questions reported); interviewers are described as understanding if you make a syntax error and let you debug it live
Technical round 2 (some pipelines): further DSA and general/behavioral questions (language choice, project rationale, willingness to switch roles)
HR round: puzzles, situational questions, "why AmEx"
extraTopics: Staying calm through visible mistakes — interviewers are reported to let candidates Google and fix their own syntax errors live
Company research for the HR round (mission/vision alignment is explicitly checked)

SE2 / SE3 (experienced).dsaDepth: Light–Moderate — AmEx is explicitly reported as caring more about clean fundamentals than flashy algorithm tricks; coding stays on the easier side (merge sort, hashmap internals) once you have a few years of experience
rounds: Recruiter screening (video, light — Java/backend fundamentals like checked vs unchecked exceptions, IOC)

Technical round: project discussion plus DSA (often easy-medium: merge sort, basic Spring Boot/Actuator questions) — interviewers may narrow the solution space and push for brute-force explanations specifically to test reasoning, not just optimization
Additional rounds (2-3 total) mixing further technical and behavioral/management conversation
extraTopics: Explaining brute-force reasoning clearly, not just jumping to an optimized answer — this is called out as a specific evaluation tactic
Spring Boot / backend framework basics for Java-stack roles
SE2 / SE3 (experienced).notes: Several 2026 India reports (Bengaluru) describe the coding bar as easy even for 3+ years of experience.

roleFamilies: Software Engineer (Gen AI/Python, per recent India postings)
